description: Shadowflame and imps - a demon knight whose Intellect is its attack power.
_source_note: Rebuilt 5 Nov 2026 from the 36 real CoA Hellfire talents (role DPS). BURNING POWER PORTS WHOLE and is the strangest stat pairing in the audit: attack power from 100% of Intellect AND spell damage from 50% of Strength, both legal pairs. PET KEYS ARE LIVE on this class - it genuinely summons three pets - unlike the Witch Doctor and Venomancer where the same keys would be dead data. pet_haste is still read by nothing, which takes Hellfire Rituals, and nothing transforms a pet, which takes Doom. Owns hellmaw (t1, gated); hellfire_form's tier-6 unlock node was dead because that ability is not gated, and is replaced with real mechanics.

nodes.name: Burning Power
nodes.description: Increases your attack power by 100% of your Intellect and your spell damage by 50% of your Strength.
nodes._source: CoA's level 20 passive, verbatim: 'Increases your attack power by 100% of your Intellect and your spell damage by 50% of your Strength.' PORTS WHOLE, and it is the strangest stat pairing in this audit: attack_power and spell_damage are both in STAT_CONVERSION_TARGETS, intellect and strength both in STAT_CONVERSION_SOURCES, so CoA's deliberate crossing works exactly. A melee demon knight whose Intellect IS its attack power is a real build here. Both are FRACTIONS.

nodes.name: Cinderblade
nodes.description: Increases your spell critical strike chance by 20% of your Intellect and your chance to hit by 6%.
nodes._source: CoA's level 30 passive: 'Increases your critical strike rating by 20% of your Intellect and your spell hit chance by 6%.' The conversion PORTS EXACTLY. The hit half is a flat 6% rather than a conversion, since hit_rating is NOT in STAT_CONVERSION_TARGETS - the sixth time in this audit that has cost a node. Together with Burning Power above, Intellect buys this spec attack power AND crit, which is why a plate melee class wants a caster stat.

nodes.name: Combusting Blade
nodes.description: Increases your Intellect by 10% and reduces the Rage cost of Infernal Strike by 20%.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Increases your Intellect by 5% and reduces the Rage cost of Infernal Strike by 5.' Doubled for the two ranks. Intellect is this spec's real scaling stat through Burning Power and Cinderblade, so this is a damage node wearing a caster's clothes. A flat 5 Rage is expressed as a percentage; POSITIVE reduces.

nodes.name: To Ashes
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of Skulltaker, Warbringer and Meatsaw by 5%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases the critical strike chance of abilities that spend Demonfire by 5%.' Demonfire is Frontier's DEATHFIRE and real, but no key names 'abilities that spend it' as a group, so CoA's three spenders are written out - the same treatment as War's Murderous Might. CoA's 5% kept.

nodes.name: Flamewrath
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of Seeking Flame by 20%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases the critical strike chance of Seeking Flame by 20%.' Ports exactly - Seeking Flame exists in Frontier and is a Deathfire generator.

nodes.name: Hellmaw
nodes.description: Teaches Hellmaw, a shadowflame strike that burns over time.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Burn an enemy with a fiery strike, dealing Shadowflame Damage, plus an additional amount over 12 seconds. Deals 20% increased damage per Demonfire consumed.' LOAD-BEARING UNLOCK: knight_of_xoroth_hellmaw carries requires_talent, so without this node it is unobtainable forever. The per-Demonfire scaling cannot be read (nothing reads a live resource amount) and lives on the ability or not at all; the talent only grants it. Kept at tier 1 where the shipped tree had it.

nodes.name: Invasion
nodes.description: Increases all damage you deal by 20%.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'All Fire damage dealt is increased by 10% to enemies above 80% health.' Doubled for the two ranks. TWO WALLS: there is no per-school damage key, and NO EFFECT KEY READS A TARGET'S HEALTH PERCENTAGE. So it becomes all_damage applying always - broader and more reliable than CoA's, stated rather than hidden. This spec deals almost nothing but fire and shadowflame, so the school widening costs little.

nodes.name: Pestilence of Apocalypse
nodes.description: Your fire strikes leave the enemy taking 10% more spell damage for 4 turns.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Emanate the Pestilence of Apocalypse, causing nearby enemies to take 10% increased Fire damage from you.' Frontier HAS Pestilence of Apocalypse as an ability and it is not gated, so this is not its unlock. There is no per-school damage-taken key beyond the existing siblings, so Fire becomes spell damage taken at CoA's own 10%; the 'from you' scoping has no key either. INSIDE A STATUS EFFECT spell_damage_taken_pct is divided by 100 and POSITIVE INCREASES damage taken.

nodes.name: Seeking Flame
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Seeking Flame by 30% and reduces its cooldown by 30%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Seeking Flame. 20 Rage. 6 sec cooldown. Generates 1 Demonfire. Sear an enemy, dealing Fire damage.' Frontier HAS Seeking Flame and it is NOT gated, so this cannot be its unlock. Built as damage and cooldown on the real ability. CoA's Grotesque ('while Hellfire Form is active, Seeking Flame has no cooldown') needs a 'while active' gate that no key provides, and is folded in here as the cooldown reduction rather than built separately.

nodes.name: Hellfire Embers
nodes.description: Increases the damage your Hellfire Imp deals by 30%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases the Fire damage dealt by your Hellfire Imp by 30% against enemies above 80% maximum health.' PET_DAMAGE IS LIVE ON THIS CLASS - Knight of Xoroth genuinely summons (call_hellfire_imp, call_hellfire_abyssal, summon_greater_imp all carry summon fields), so the key reaches something real. That is not true of most classes: the same key would have been dead data on the Witch Doctor and Venomancer, which is what tools/qa_pet_keys.py checks. The health-threshold condition cannot be read, so CoA's 30% applies always.

nodes.name: Calamity
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Unleash Pestilence by 25%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases the damage of the Unleash effect of Pestilence of Apocalypse by 25% and its duration is increased by 5 sec.' CoA's 'Unleash effect' is Unleash Pestilence, which Frontier has as its own ability. The duration half is dropped: it refers to the Pestilence buff rather than the Unleash, and no key extends another effect's duration.

nodes.name: Claws of Hell
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your Deathfire spenders by 20%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'When you spend at least 4 Demonfire stacks you now refresh the duration of your Unleash Apocalypse on the target.' Two walls: nothing reads how much Deathfire a cast spent, and no payload refreshes a live effect's duration. So neither half is buildable. Re-pointed at the spenders' damage, which is what spending four Demonfire was for.

nodes.name: Seething Strikes
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Sever by 30%, and it leaves the enemy taking 3% more spell damage for 4 turns.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases the damage of Sever by 30% against Burning targets and it now increases the targets chance to be critically struck by 3% for 12 seconds.' The Burning condition cannot be read - no effect key reads a target's debuffs - and this spec burns everything anyway. THERE IS NO RECIPIENT-SIDE 'CHANCE TO BE CRIT' KEY, so that becomes spell damage taken at CoA's own 3%; 12 sec is 4 turns.

nodes.name: Inferno Blast
nodes.description: Increases your critical strike damage by 40%.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Increases your critical damage against Burning targets by 20%.' Doubled for the two ranks. The Burning condition cannot be read, so CoA's figure applies always. crit_damage_physical is a FRACTION.

nodes.name: Infernal Pummeling
nodes.description: Melt leaves the enemy taking 10% more damage for 4 turns.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Melt now increases the damage your target takes from Flames of Xoroth and Skulltaker by 10%.' The per-ability scoping has no key, so it is damage taken generally at CoA's own 10%. BARE damage_taken_pct IS READ RAW, so 10% is 0.10 - authoring 10.0 would be +1000% damage taken, the mirror of the -20.0 that briefly made Boltslinger immortal.

nodes.name: Rain of Chaos
nodes.description: Flames of Xoroth calls down molten rain, burning the enemy for fire damage over 3 turns.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Casting Flames of Xoroth with 6 Demonfire now calls down a Rain of Chaos. Molten rain burns enemies in the area causing Fire Damage over 9 sec.' The 6-Demonfire condition cannot be read (nothing reads a live resource amount), so it fires on every cast. A burning area over 9 sec IS a dot, so the rest ports in shape - 9 sec as 3 turns, landing on the target rather than an area since there is no ground placement.

nodes.name: Hellfire Rituals
nodes.description: Increases the health and armour of your demons by 30%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Critical strikes with Skulltaker now increases the haste of your Greater Imp by 15% for 8 seconds.' TWO WALLS: PET_HASTE IS READ BY NOTHING, and no proc payload can apply an effect to a pet - apply_effect reaches the caster or the trigger's target only. Re-pointed at the two remaining live pet keys, which is a longer-lived demon rather than a faster one. The keys DO work here because this class really summons; the same node on the Witch Doctor would have been dead data.

nodes.name: Indiscriminate
nodes.description: Seeking Flame splashes 45% of its damage onto up to 3 nearby enemies.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Seeking Flame now spreads Hellmaw and Melt from the target to up to 3 enemies within 6 yds.' SPREADING DOTS TO NEW TARGETS IS NOT A PAYLOAD - apply_effect lands on the trigger's own target - so it becomes splash_damage at CoA's three targets, the same translation as the Witch Doctor's Malignant and Templar Crusader's Holy Tempest.

nodes.name: Doom
nodes.description: Increases the damage your demons deal by a further 40%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Transforms your Greater Imp into a Doomguard for 12 seconds. While transformed, your Doomguard deals 20% more damage, and its auto attacks ignite the target, dealing 10% of the damage dealt as Fire damage over 6 seconds, stacking 6 times.' NOTHING TRANSFORMS A PET, and PETS NEVER FIRE PROCS - there is no fire_proc_trigger anywhere in entities/pet.py - so the ignite rider cannot exist either. Re-pointed at pet_damage, stacking with Hellfire Embers at tier 1 for 70% on a full Hellfire build, which is what a Doomguard was worth.

nodes.name: Hellbringer
nodes.description: Increases all damage you deal by a further 10%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases the all damage dealt by party and raid members by 3%. Does not stack with similar effects.' A TALENT CANNOT REACH AN ALLY - get_talent_effects() reads only the character's own trees - so the 3% lands on the Knight and the description says 'you'. Raised to 10% because it covers one character instead of five, the same reasoning as the Witch Doctor's Spirit of Battle.

nodes.name: Grotesque
nodes.description: Your fire strikes grant 5 Deathfire.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'While Hellfire Form is active, your Seeking Flame now has no cooldown and generates an additional Demonfire.' The 'while active' gate has no key and the cooldown half is already carried by the Seeking Flame node at tier 1. What survives is the extra Demonfire, granted off every fire strike rather than only in form - DEATHFIRE IS REAL (ResourceType.DEATHFIRE, four abilities generate into it), verified through gain_resource on the War tree. 1-turn icd so a multi-strike turn does not flood the pool.

nodes.name: Hellfire Form
nodes.description: Increases your spell damage by 20% and your spell critical strike chance by 15%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Enter your Hellfire Form, increasing your Fire damage dealt by 20% and Fire critical strike chance by 15% for 15 sec.' Frontier HAS Hellfire Form as an ability and it is NOT talent-gated - the shipped tree carried an unlock node for it at tier 6, which therefore granted an ability the character already had and did nothing. This replaces that with the form's own numbers as a permanent passive: CoA's 20% and 15%, with the per-school scoping dropped (no per-school damage or crit key exists). Moved from tier 6 to 5 so tier 6 can carry a real capstone.

nodes.name: Molten Fury
nodes.description: Your critical strikes with fire strikes burn for extra fire damage.
nodes._source: Built from CoA's Inferno Blast and Rain of Chaos themes rather than ported from one talent, so tier 5 carries a proc instead of a third flat damage line - and flagged as such. It fires off the three fire strikes the whole tree buffs, so it rewards the rotation the spec actually runs.

nodes.name: Hellstorm
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Hellstorm and your fire strikes by 40%, and your damage-over-time spells by 25%.
nodes._source: Frontier HAS Hellstorm as an ability and it is not gated, so this capstone grants nothing - the tree's only gated ability is Hellmaw at tier 1. Built as a pure payoff node on the three fire strikes the tree is about plus Hellstorm itself, and the dot bonus reaches Hellmaw's burn and Rain of Chaos at tier 3. NOT a port of a specific CoA talent - the shipped tree's tier 6 was a dead unlock node for Hellfire Form, whose real numbers now sit at tier 5 - and flagged as such.
